title: Live app-owned and full-size checkpoint projections on Hexagon V79

constraints_solved: SELinux denies adb shell direct write into /data/data/<pkg>/files
steps: adb install -r app-debug.apk (same debug-keystore signature as release; install -r preserves app data)
adb exec-in run-as dev.tensorfold.mobile sh -c 'cat > files/tensorfold/qnn/live-checkpoint-v1.bin' < host-payload (stream workstation bytes via pipe)
adb install -r app-release.apk (restores production debuggable=false flag)
launch release APK: QnnProbe.kt reads the staged payloads

restart_recovery.test: am force-stop dev.tensorfold.mobile; sleep 2; am start -n dev.tensorfold.mobile/.MainActivity
restart_recovery.result: all four projections pass with equivalent timings and error (max_abs_error 0.0093 unchanged)
restart_recovery.note: The QNN in-memory context does not literally survive process death; the test shows the on-disk payload + deterministic context rebuild path survives it (persistent full passes with first=2.55 ms, warm median=1.22 ms after restart).

scope_guards_honored: no new CUDA or Vulkan kernel
no chat UI or model downloader added
did not claim full-model NPU inference from one-layer projection evidence
did not claim an end-to-end TFOLD inference speedup from these isolated projection timings
honest_limitations: Both source-model dequantization and payload generation ran on a separate Linux ARM64 host (GB10 Spark), not on the phone. The phone only executes QNN on the pre-staged quantized payloads.
The Windows host build of the generator failed because Zig 0.17.0 std.DynLib does not compile against windows-msvc; we cross-compiled to aarch64-linux-gnu instead.
The three live-checkpoint negative tests (missing/corrupt/wrong-sha) ran against the 128x128 checkpoint payload only; we did not re-run them for the 12 MB full payload. Same code path.

App-restart recovery was verified via am force-stop + am start. We did not test device reboot recovery (payload file persists through reboot since it's in internal storage, but the full-device reboot cycle was not executed this session).
